description: TESS, the Transactive Energy Service System, is a platform from SLAC's GISMo group for studying retail electricity transactions among distributed resources. It contains bidding agents, retail market-clearing logic, simulations and deployment components for behind-the-meter generation and storage. Users define resource fleets, bids, tariffs and operating conditions; outputs include prices, schedules and simulated participation under the selected market design. Geographic coverage is a configured utility or community, not a supplied grid territory. GPL-3.0 source, user-doc folders and version tags are public. A limitation is that market behaviour depends on agent and tariff assumptions, while a pilot deployment also needs utility systems and security review. TESS can compare demand flexibility and distributed storage effects on distribution-system resilience. The related catalogue PyPSA optimises grid operation at a different scale. No utility data, cloud deployment or package was downloaded.
